new_assertions.title: current target quotient erases a locally phase-determining endpoint coordinate
new_assertions.body: On the shortest two-route family, target residual-token-197700 membership determines the observed route phase, yet the current target quotient merges the two final states with opposite values of that bit.

new_assertions.title: target-only state refinement is sufficient for local satisfiability
new_assertions.body: For the shortest 5x4 witness, the source quotient node and both intermediate nodes may remain unchanged; splitting only the merged target by residual-token-197700 membership is sufficient to make the scalar Boolean edge equations satisfiable.

new_assertions.title: refined shortest witness has exactly global-complement gauge freedom
new_assertions.body: The residual-bit-refined shortest-witness constraint system has exactly two Boolean node assignments, and one is obtained from the other by complementing every node phase bit.

new_assertions.title: fixing source phase uniquely fixes the refined shortest witness
new_assertions.body: In the residual-bit-refined shortest system, choosing the source node phase bit fixes every intermediate and target phase bit uniquely.

new_assertions.title: refined target potential equals source potential XOR residual bit
new_assertions.body: For each shortest route in every satisfying refined assignment, target_phase = source_phase XOR final_P0_residual_197700_membership.

new_assertions.title: final residual bit is an exact local phase correction term
new_assertions.body: For both shortest routes, observed_route_phase XOR final_P0_residual_197700_membership = 0.

rejected_candidates.body: The literal residual token 197700 is the unique correction term.
rejected_candidates.reason: Local exact fit does not prove uniqueness; alternative refinements may also separate the target states.

rejected_candidates.body: A target-only refinement suffices for the entire 5x4 carrier.
rejected_candidates.reason: SC-IA037 is restricted to one concrete obstruction.
